content: 2026 NIST guidance: min password length 15 (CISA recommends 16), complexity rules (must have upper/number/symbol) no longer recommended, forced rotation dead. Password managers should default generator to length-first (16-20+ chars) not symbol-stuffing. Passphrase mode: 4-6 random dictionary words (EFF-style wordlist, ~12-13 bits/word) generated by the tool, never user-picked.
